newsitem.title: ECUADOR: Ecuador banana exports up 20 percent in Jan-March.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador banana exports up 20 percent in Jan-March.

text.p: Ecuador banana exports totaled 1.14 million tonnes in the January-March period, up 20 percent from the first three months of 1996, the official National Banana Program (PNB) said Tuesday.
In the first three months of 1996, Ecuador exported 951,084 tonnes of bananas.
PNB added that Ecuador earned $339.2 million from banana exports in the first three months of 1997, up from $232.6 million in the same period of 1996.
Ecuador, the world's top banana exporter, sold 3.84 million tonnes abroad in 1996 and 3.7 million tonnes in 1995.
The European Union was the largest buyer in the Jan-March period at 455,336 tonnes for $93.5 million, while the United States was the second, at 272,351 tonnes for $82.3 million.
